name: Emil P.
preview: Sarah: Before you go, one thing: what made you add the Thor P2 and the BC04 while you were still waiting on your Magic M. 40T?

messages.text:
Hi Emil. We don't give discount codes for Trustpilot reviews. Reviews have to stay honest and unpaid, so we never attach a reward to one.

If you'd like to leave one anyway, we'd really appreciate it: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

Did you see a review-code offer somewhere on our site or in an email? If you did, tell me where and I'll look into it. And if there's anything else, like your three orders, just ask.

Thanks for sending that, Emil. That's our "How did we do?" email. It asks for a review now that your order has landed, but nothing in the part you've shown mentions a discount code. We don't reward reviews with codes, so the review stays honest.

If further down that email does promise a code, send me a screenshot of that part and I'll take it up with the team. And if you do leave a review, thank you, it really helps a small shop like ours.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)
Handed to the team · The code offer is outside my discount rules ($75 is over my cap ····'s tied to

You're right, Emil, and I'm sorry. That email does offer a $75 code for a Trustpilot review, so I was wrong to say we never do that.

I can't issue that code myself. I've sent your screenshots to the team, and someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email.

Have you posted the review yet? If you have, send me a screenshot of it here and I'll add it to your ticket.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Thanks, Emil. That shows your review went live on Trustpilot, posted as "E P". It's now on your ticket with the email screenshots, so the team has everything they need to check it.

I can't confirm the $75 code myself. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email with an answer, so you don't need to stay here.

Thanks for taking the time to write the review.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Thanks, Emil. I can see it: a 5-star review from "E P" saying the gear was easy to plug and play and delivery was quick. It's added to your ticket with the rest.

Thank you for the kind words. The team has everything they need to check the $75 code, and someone will get back to you by email.
It was for orders Shop···· and Shop····

Got it, Emil. The review covers Shop····, the Thor P2, and Shop····, the BC04. I've noted both on your ticket.

I can't promise whether that means one code or one for each order. The team will decide and confirm it when they email you.
Before you go, one thing: what made you add the Thor P2 and the BC04 while you were still waiting on your Magic M. 40T?
